title: 曾被叫小黄书：一年卖近十亿美元，美国读者为何疯抢？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Romanticity is a term that was made a couple of years ago, really in response to this new genre of books that combine romance elements with fantasy and
segments.zh: 浪漫奇幻是几年前创造的一个术语，用来描述融合了浪漫元素与奇幻元素的新书类型。

segments.en: Romanticity fans don't just read the books. They live them Romanticity is my favorite fantasy romance. I love fantasy
segments.zh: 浪漫奇幻的粉丝不只是读书，他们沉浸其中。浪漫奇幻是我最喜欢的奇幻浪漫，我喜欢奇幻。

segments.en: These stories are a little bit spicier than tells that you may read in middle school You've got steamy scenes between humans and fairies and vampires and werewolves. There's characters known as shadow daddies
segments.zh: 这些故事比你在中学读到的要更火辣一些。有人类与精灵、吸血鬼和狼人之间的激情场景，还有被称为“暗影爸爸”的角色。

segments.en: There's also a lot of tropes like love triangles enemies to lovers and people go crazy for these books I do have a shopping problem. I do have five coffees of the ever-king, but they're all different
segments.zh: 还有很多套路，比如三角恋、宿敌变情人，人们为这些书疯狂。我确实有购物癖，我有五杯永恒之王的咖啡，但都是不同的。

segments.en: A lot of people still write it off as something that's frivolous, you know, it's called smut, but that's changing This genre's fiercely loyal fan base has become its own economic engine. There are trivia nights
segments.zh: 很多人仍然把它视为轻浮的东西，称之为“小黄书”，但这种情况正在改变。这个类型拥有极其忠诚的粉丝群，已成为自己的经济引擎。有问答之夜。

segments.en: There are contests. There are launch parties for new books that are coming out People go to events that are inspired by actual events in the books. They get to dress up
segments.zh: 有比赛，有新书发布派对。人们参加受书中情节启发的活动，可以打扮起来。

segments.en: They buy merchandise. There are book conferences. There are retreats I mean, it is really an industry that gets into all aspects of life
segments.zh: 他们购买周边商品，还有书展和静修会。这确实是一个渗透到生活各个方面的产业。

segments.en: This is a trend that's going to last for another few years at least in 2025 romanticy book sales totaled almost one billion dollars in the US alone
segments.zh: 这一趋势至少还会持续几年。2025年，浪漫奇幻图书在美国的销售额总计接近十亿美元。
